# Knee radiograph

```fc-occlusion
image: [[knee-lateral-radiograph.png]]
mode: hide-all
header: Lateral knee radiograph, name the structure
k7fq rect 0.412 0.228 0.12 0.06 "Patella"
2mxa rect 0.605 0.512 0.098 0.071 "Fibular head"
9c0d ellipse 0.301 0.64 0.08 0.08 "Tibial tubercle"
p4e1 poly 0.51,0.44 0.57,0.43 0.58,0.49 0.52,0.5 "Blumensaat's line"
r5tw rect 0.33 0.3 0.04 0.09 "Patellar tendon"
w1ky rect 0.318 0.48 0.04 0.11 "Patellar tendon"
group b8zn = r5tw w1ky
```
Insall–Salvati ratio = patellar tendon length ÷ patellar length (normal 0.8–1.2).

The Insall–Salvati ratio is normally ==0.8–1.2==.
